item.title: You’re Invited: 10th High School Chidon Championship
item.description: Women and girls are invited: Next Sunday night, Batsheva Learning Center hosts the 10th Annual High School Chidon Championship in Crown Heights, culminating a months-long Torah learning journey of 450 High School girls. Full Story

item.title: May an AI or Robot Perform Work for Me on Shabbos?
item.description: Episode 5 “Lemaan Yishmeu” weekly halacha podcast with Rabbi Yosef Yeshaya Braun, Mara D’asra, and member of the Crown Heights Beis Din, addressing intriguing halachic questions on a wide range of practical topics. Full Story

item.title: Menahelim Learn About Connection at MEF Florida
item.description: The Chabad School Leadership for Menahelim brought together 55 principals of boys schools from as far as South Africa, Argentina, and across the United States and Canada, for two packed days of learning, networking, inspiration and growth, on 5-6 Adar/February 22-23. Full Story

item.title: Prof. Baruch Bush, 78, OBM
item.description: Professor Baruch Bush, a longtime resident of Crown Heights and beloved member of the community, passed away peacefully just before Shabbos, 10 Adar, 5786. Full Story

item.title: Head Shliach Joins NW Florida Yeshiva for Father-Son Shabbaton
item.description: Yeshivas Lubavitch Northwest Florida recently hosted the Talmidim’s fathers for a meaningful and uplifting Shabbos led by renowned Shliach, Rabbi Moshe Feller, Head Shliach of Minnesota. Full Story

item.title: Chassidus in Color: Spotlight Submission
item.description: See the Chassidus in Color entry by Akiva Forer - 18, from Florida, of the 12 Pesukim come to life. Full Story

item.title: What Lessons Can We Learn From Purim About the Iran War?
item.description: Applied Chassidus with Rabbi Simon Jacobson: Purim and Persia: Then and Now; What Lessons Can We Learn From Purim About Today’s Events in Iran? What Are the Parallels Between Ancient and Modern-Day Persia? Full Story

item.title: Time Travel to Shushan: AI Project Lets You Step Inside the Megillah
item.description: A new digital project is bringing the Megillah to life like never before, offering a fully immersive, three dimensional reconstruction of Shushan Habirah and the palace of Achashverosh, created by Guilford, Connecticut Shliach Rabbi Yossi Yaffe. Full Story

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Recap: Bochurim’s Day of Hiskashrus and Achievement
item.description: Watch: A powerful recap video capturing the energy, inspiration, and accomplishment of Yud Shevat and the Halikut Siyum with the Vaad Talmidei Hatmimim, from the Kinus Hachana near the Ohel to the central Farbrengen and unforgettable Siyum celebration. Video
